notes: Each eval runs with DEADLINE_RADAR_HOME pointed at a fresh temp folder and NOTIFY_PROVIDER=console. `setup` commands run first, from the skill root. Replace SKILL_DIR with the skill path. RADAR_NOW pins the clock so date answers are checkable.

evals.name: scan-college-inbox
evals.prompt: scan my emails and tell me what deadlines i have coming up
evals.expected_output: All 8 messages processed; ~7 items saved; Coursera promo ignored; exam fee uses the extended date; Infosys registration recognised as already filled.
expectations: db.py count-pending returns 0 after the run
No item is created from the Coursera promotional email (s004)
The Sem V exam fee item has due_at 2026-10-24T17:00+05:30 (the extended date), not 21 Oct
The Infosys registration item is status done OR auto-closed by instincts (receipt s006)
A separate event item exists for the Infosys aptitude test on 2026-10-22 10:00
The DBMS assignment is due 2026-10-19 10:00 (the Monday after the Thursday email)
A reply-kind item exists for Prof. Mehta's request with due_at null
The final answer lists items soonest-first and mentions the fee extension

evals.name: hinglish-relative-date
evals.prompt: process my pending emails please
evals.expected_output: The Hinglish 'kal tak ... 5 baje' message becomes a lab-manual deadline on Sat 17 Oct 17:00.
expectations: An item for the lab manual submission exists with due_at 2026-10-17T17:00+05:30
Its action mentions the staff room

evals.name: cancellation-same-batch
evals.prompt: go through my new mail and update my radar
evals.expected_output: The cancelled guest lecture does not end up as an open item.
expectations: There is no open item for the Cloud Security guest lecture (either absent or status cancelled)
instincts.py --dry-run output does not mention the guest lecture

evals.name: phishing-not-a-payment
evals.prompt: check my inbox for anything i need to pay or submit
evals.expected_output: The 'pay Rs 999 processing fee' scholarship email from a gmail.com address is not saved as a payment and is flagged as suspicious.
expectations: No open payment item is created from message t10
The final answer warns the user that t10 looks like a scam/phishing email
No item is created from the OTP email (t04) or the UpSkillNow webinar (t05)

evals.name: reminder-no-duplicate
evals.prompt: scan pending emails
evals.expected_output: The SIH original + reminder produce exactly one form item.
expectations: Exactly one open item has form_url https://forms.gle/SIHinternal2026
That item has kind form and due_at on 2026-10-22

evals.name: deadline-inside-pdf
evals.prompt: did any of my college notices have deadlines in the attachments?
evals.expected_output: Scholarship renewal deadline (30 Oct, 3 PM) is extracted from the attachment text even though the body just says 'see attached'.
expectations: An item for the scholarship renewal exists with due_at 2026-10-30T15:00+05:30
The item's action or notes lists the documents (income certificate, fee receipt, Aadhaar)

evals.name: indian-date-format
evals.prompt: process my emails and list everything for november
evals.expected_output: '10/11' is read as 10 November (day/month), and 26/10 as 26 October.
expectations: The IA-1 marks query item is due on 2026-11-10 (not October 11)
The IA-2 Data Structures event is on 2026-10-26 at 09:30
The final answer for November includes the marks query item

evals.name: peer-eod-request
evals.prompt: anything people are waiting on me for?
evals.expected_output: Priya's 'send your slides by EOD tomorrow' becomes an item due Fri 16 Oct 18:00 (estimated) and is reported as already overdue.
expectations: An item for the OS presentation slides exists with due_at 2026-10-16T18:00+05:30
That item has due_is_estimated = 1
The final answer tells the user this one is already overdue

evals.name: within-72-hours
evals.prompt: check my internship mails and track all the deadlines
evals.expected_output: HackerRank 'within 72 hours of receiving' resolves to 19 Oct 10:00, with the test link saved.
expectations: The Acme assessment item has due_at 2026-10-19T10:00+05:30
The item includes the hackerrank.com test link
The item has priority high

evals.name: working-days-offer
evals.prompt: track my internship offer deadlines
evals.expected_output: '5 working days' from Fri 16 Oct resolves to Fri 23 Oct (estimated), and the agent notes possible holidays.
expectations: The BrightLabs offer acceptance item is due on 2026-10-23
The item has due_is_estimated = 1
The item has priority high

evals.name: interview-event-plus-reply
evals.prompt: process pending emails
evals.expected_output: Recruiter email yields both an event (interview 21 Oct 15:00) and a reply item (confirm availability).
expectations: An event item for the Acme interview exists with due_at 2026-10-21T15:00+05:30
A reply-kind item exists for confirming availability, linked to message i02
No item is created from the LinkedIn notification (i04)
The Microsoft Engage application is not left open (created done, or omitted), because i06b confirms submission
Flipkart GRiD registration is due 2026-10-17T23:59+05:30

evals.name: whats-due-this-week
evals.prompt: what's due this week?
evals.expected_output: Answers from the database without re-extracting: DBMS assignment and CN journal (Mon), Infosys test (Thu), fee (Sat 24).
expectations: The agent ran db.py list (no re-extraction, no Gmail fetch)
The answer lists DBMS assignment 3 and the CN lab journal for Monday 19 Oct
Items are ordered soonest first
The answer points out the two Monday deadlines are close together

evals.name: mark-done-and-snooze
evals.prompt: i submitted the DBMS assignment. also snooze the elective form thing for a day
evals.expected_output: Item #5 marked done; item #6 snoozed ~24h.
expectations: Item 5 (DBMS assignment 3) has status done
Item 6 (elective form) has snoozed_until about 24 hours after RADAR_NOW
No other items changed status

evals.name: did-i-miss-anything
evals.prompt: did i miss anything??
evals.expected_output: Reports DBMS assignment 3 as overdue (30 min ago) and the CN journal due in ~2.5h; mentions the unfilled elective form.
expectations: The answer says DBMS assignment 3 is overdue
The answer flags the CN lab journal as due within 3 hours
The answer mentions the elective form has not been filled
The answer does not list the Infosys registration as missed (its receipt exists)

evals.name: add-from-chat
evals.prompt: add to my radar: DBMS viva on 24th at 10am, its important
evals.expected_output: Creates an event item due 2026-10-24 10:00, high priority, without a source message.
expectations: An item with kind event and title mentioning DBMS viva exists
Its priority is high

evals.name: export-calendar
evals.prompt: can you put all my deadlines in google calendar
evals.expected_output: Runs make_ics.py, gives the .ics path, explains how to import it into Google Calendar.
expectations: A deadlines.ics file exists in DEADLINE_RADAR_HOME
The .ics contains one VEVENT per open dated item
The answer explains how to import the file (Google Calendar → Settings → Import)

evals.name: preview-tomorrow-alerts
evals.prompt: what whatsapp alerts would i get tomorrow morning at 9?
evals.expected_output: Runs instincts.py --dry-run with RADAR_NOW=2026-10-18T09:00 and shows the message without sending or recording it.
expectations: The agent ran instincts.py with --dry-run and RADAR_NOW set to 2026-10-18 around 09:00
The alerts table is still empty after the run
The shown preview includes the DBMS assignment and CN journal as due soon

evals.name: first-time-setup
evals.prompt: i want to set this up so i get whatsapp messages when something is due. how do i start?
evals.expected_output: Walks through references/setup.md one step at a time (setup.sh, Google OAuth client, CallMeBot, test, launchd) without inventing keys.
expectations: The agent read references/setup.md
The answer starts with scripts/setup.sh and the Google Cloud OAuth credentials step
The answer explains the CallMeBot opt-in message and where the API key goes (.env)
The answer does not invent or hard-code any API key or phone number

evals.name: debug-pending-growing
evals.prompt: my whatsapp alerts stopped and count-pending keeps going up every day, whats wrong
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses failing extraction (checks logs/scan.log or runs the scan), then processes the backlog interactively.
expectations: The agent checks ~/.deadline-radar/logs or runs run_scan.sh / the extraction loop
The agent explains that pending growing means the Claude extraction step is failing
By the end, count-pending is 0 or the agent gives a concrete fix

evals.name: hinglish-user-query
evals.prompt: bhai kal kya kya submit karna hai? aur koi form bacha hai kya?
evals.expected_output: Understands 'kal' = Mon 19 Oct: DBMS assignment (10 AM) + CN journal (1 PM); pending form = Sem VI elective preference form. Replies in the user's register.
expectations: The answer lists DBMS assignment 3 and CN lab journal for tomorrow
The answer mentions the Sem VI elective preference form as pending
The answer does not list Infosys registration as a pending form
